gallery.alt: Sami standing alone on a winter morning
gallery.description: A quiet winter morning, standing alone as the warm sun gently fell on me — one of those peaceful moments you never forget.

gallery.alt: Sami's cat sitting on his lap
gallery.description: My cat decided my lap was his favourite place in the world — and honestly, I did not mind one bit.
My little rabbit back home in Bangladesh — she holds a special place in my heart and I miss her dearly every day.
Bangor University — the place I now call my second home, where every day brings a new challenge and a new opportunity.

gallery.alt: Stunning city view from above with a bird
gallery.description: The city looked absolutely stunning from up here — and to make it even more special, a bird flew right up to me as if we were old friends.
Went out to explore the city and soak in everything it had to offer — every street had its own story to tell.
Attending Jummah prayer on a Friday — a moment of peace, reflection, and gratitude that grounds me no matter where I am in the world.
This was taken during the July Movement in Bangladesh — a time I stood up and raised my voice alongside thousands of others for our rights and our future.
The city at night is an absolute beauty — the lights, the energy, the vibes. I could stand here and take it all in forever.
